extraction_notes: MM1Z5V6 is one line item of the multi-part datasheet 'MM1Z2V0 THRU MM1Z75' by Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd (www.ichjc.com); type code 4P, SOD-123 package.
Electrical Characteristics row for MM1Z5V6 (page 2, Ta = 25 C): VZ min 5.2 V / nom 5.6 V / max 6.0 V at IZT = 5 mA; maximum zener impedance ZZT = 80 ohm @ IZT; leakage IR = 1 uA max @ VR = 2.5 V.
Maximum Ratings (page 1): power dissipation PD = 500 mW; VF = 0.9 V max @ IF = 10 mA; Tj and Tstg -55 to +150 C; typical thermal resistance RthJ-A = 340 C/W.
The Electrical Parameter section on page 1 defines IZK/ZZK symbols but the per-part table gives no IZK or ZZK@IZK values for this series, so no knee-impedance point is recorded.

Fig.1 Zener Characteristics (page 3) includes a 5V6 trace (IZ 0-50 mA vs VZ 0-10 V, pulsed, Ta = 25 C), but it is a small composite sketch with a near-vertical breakdown trace; digitizing it would not yield reliably correct points, so per the table-first policy no curve points were taken. Fig.3 Power Derating and Fig.4 Transient Thermal Impedance are thermal ratings, not electrical model curves.
Values taken from the public datasheet PDF only (SHA-256 ff4a1051509db45f49817a41e5674adc11a1dea2a91e51ee958ffaed19b1d755); no vendor SPICE or model packs consulted.
omission_reason: The only electrical characteristic figures are the composite Fig.1/Fig.2 zener-characteristic sketches shared across the whole MM1Z series; the 5V6 trace in Fig.1 is a near-vertical breakdown curve on a coarse 0-10 V axis, too imprecise to digitize without inventing points. Extraction therefore relies on the tabulated limits: single-point VF maximum, zener voltage window at IZT, ZZT, and IR leakage.
